slot_note: Numbered from seed RC08 (a wind turbine's five faults and its one spring crew visit). The seed's world collides with shipped task187 (a wind farm's lost production read against the warranted curve) and its kernel, a unit's own healthy year as the reference curve, is task187's family; the seed's client domain (Supply Chain & Logistics) carries Root-Cause only through interpretability, ruled a backdrop for an operations world at task129 v1. Moved to another client domain, world and dataset under the same objective and number, keeping the decision kind (one of five causes gets the single fix) and the quantity's kind (what that cause cost over the period, in the period's natural unit).
niche: an NHS Talking Therapies service's 2025-26 fall in recoveries: which of five service changes gets the commissioner's one 2026-27 improvement, when agency high-intensity cover bought to clear the step 3 backlog lapsed block by block and the courses it held were reallocated mid-course, so the loss reads as the waiting list's early leavers
answer: A: agency high-intensity therapists on 12-week assignments cost about 250 recoveries in 2025-26 (to the nearest 50); fund fixed-term high-intensity posts
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and the national recovery definition correctly walks the year's fall down the referral-to-recovery funnel, finds it in step 3 courses that ended early, sees early endings climb with the wait while agency therapists' recovery rates on the courses they discharged match employed ones, and files C, the step 3 waiting list, at about 310 recoveries; the loss runs through the courses an agency therapist's lapsing assignment broke off, and long waiters whose therapist stayed end early no more often than short waiters.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a mediation decomposition, the task type's own analysis: the wait's total association with early ending and lost recovery split into the path that runs through allocation to agency cover whose assignment lapsed mid-course (handover, then disengagement, the therapist-discontinuity dropout the psychotherapy literature reports) and the wait's direct path, which is about zero; a noun swap keeps the arithmetic of a split but loses the mediator, the continuity of one therapist across a course scored session by session against caseness, so the decomposition has no path to read.
layer1: an electronic record migration in October 2025 that re-keyed practitioner identifiers, joined back only through a directory whose names differ from the staffing system's
a temporary staffing register in which an assignment extended is a new row, not an end
outcome measures exported as item-level answers before the migration and totals after it
a monthly KPI report filed with preliminary figures that the refreshed extract revises
appointment times in local time against a staffing system stamped in UTC
fiscal year April to March against calendar-month extracts
agency timesheets recorded as weekly totals, a correction filed as a replacement timesheet on the agency portal and as an adjustment line on e-rostering from 1 August 2025
waiting list snapshots taken after the month end, a patient removed only when the first appointment is outcomed
a digital vendor's section-level event export in UTC across a content release
stakeholder_role: head of psychological therapies for the service

spine.entity: one appointment booked within one referral's course of therapy

world.geography: England, a fictional county integrated care board area
world.org_type: a mental health charity delivering the county's NHS Talking Therapies service under contract to the integrated care board (stepped care, steps 2 and 3)

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a long wait's apparent harm that runs through the actor the waiting cases were given to, whose fixed-term assignment lapsed mid-case so the case was handed on and abandoned, against the wait's direct path, read only by setting each case's run of actors against the assignment register; because the arrangement was used on the longest-waiting cases, the loss reads as the wait's.
driver_concrete: Each step 3 course's run of high-intensity therapists, rebuilt from the care contacts across the record migration, set against the agency booking log's assignment ends: the courses an agency block's lapse broke off lose most of their patients after the reallocation, the wait's direct path is about zero among courses whose therapist stayed, and because agency cover took the backlog the loss reads as the waiting list's.
stump: A solver who walks the fall down the referral-to-recovery funnel finds it in step 3 courses ending early, sees early endings rise with the wait while agency therapists' recovery rates match employed ones, and files C, the waiting list; the step that lands it there is never splitting the wait's effect by setting each course's run of therapists against the agency booking log, which puts the loss on the courses a lapsing agency block broke off and the call on A.

differentiation.task245: task245 rebuilds the periods a recorder missed because it fails under its heaviest load; here every appointment is recorded, and the loss is the courses an agency assignment's end broke off, found by setting each course's run of therapists against the staffing register's end dates.
differentiation.task270: task270 v6 places unscheduled advertising spots from a traffic system's past placements to read a schedule's reach; here the decisive relation is a therapy course's run of practitioners against assignment end dates, and the loss is the patients who leave after a handover, which the recovery rate on finished courses never counts.
differentiation.task399: task399 reads an advocate's absence at the moment each case is decided, which confounds another decision-maker's measured disparity; here a therapist's departure breaks a course already under way, the patient is lost after the handover, and the loss is a mediated path of the wait counted over every course begun, not an absence at a decision.

notes: Strategy population_selection: the decisive move fixes which courses carry the change (the ones an agency block lapse broke off, an exposure no column marks), which is what splits the wait total effect into its mediated and direct paths. Gate G decomposition_attribution: a correctly counted fall assigned to the right change; the only honest Gate G key for a root-cause call, so the wave repeat WARN is answered by the strategies differing (composition_mix, causal_design, binding_constraint, population_selection). Decisive generator G9: the service measures each therapist recovery rate on the courses the therapist kept to discharge, and the courses an agency therapist lost when the block lapsed sit behind the care-contact to booking-log join. G4 and G6 were tried as the decisive generator at stage 2 and refused by the guard (test.same_driver against task232 v2, task121 v6, task129 v2, task243; test.same_puzzle_older against task144, task228, task265, task68), so they stay as frame. The recovery rate counting only finished courses carries about one broken course in eight (84 of 714 at seed 402) and is kept out of the driver.
